headline: "Influenced by Korean Stocks, Investor Enthusiasm Lukewarm" Japan's Nikkei Was 'Bundle-Traded,' Local Securities Industry Says
summary: Japanese securities industry members voiced concern about the Nikkei moving in linkage with Korean stocks. A trader said foreign long-only funds are instead investing in domestic-oriented shares.
why: The Nikkei 225 is Japan's benchmark stock index, and its behaviour matters for global Asian equity allocations. Correlated trading across Asian markets can affect portfolio flows and index-level risk.
